Carbon monoxide (CO) concentrations were calculated utilizing traffic assignment projections. In the air quality analysis, the California diffusion models as described in FEDERAL HIGHWAY ADMINISTRATION'S (FHWA), "AIR QUALITY MANUAL, VOLUME IV", and the Illinois Department of Transportation "Air Quality Manual" were used to compute ambient air quality and the one-hour and eight-hour maximum concentrations based on traffic volumes derived from average daily traffic (ADT) counts and projections. The analytical procedures for divided highways with medians was followed. In this analysis, the ADT was divided in half and applied to one-half the system. The pollutant concentration was calculated for its contribution to the other half of the system and added to the roadway source on the other half; then the combined concentration wad calculated. This procedure results in a more accurate appraisal of carbon monoxide concentrations. Heavy-duty vehicle emissions, gasoline and diesel, have been combined with light-duty vehicle emissions in proportion to agree with observed percentages where possible. In all cases where percentage mixes have not been determined by observation, a mix of 85 percent gasoline versus 15 percent diesel for heavy-duty vehicles is assumed. A 10 percent heavy-duty mix with 90 percent light-duty vehicles is assumed where actual percentages have not been determined by observation. The values assumed for these calculations are credible based on a review of traffic characteristic studies for both Illinois and the nation as a whole.
Current ambient pollutant concentrations are calculated in most cases since actual observations are normally not available. These calculations are based on current ADT, Pasquille Stability Class D, a wind speed of five meters per second (10 knots or 11 mph) and the most frequent wind direction relative to the alignment of the project. These assumed values are valid for the whole State and were determined from a study of all wind rose/stability tables available for the State and immediately adjacent selected locations.
